response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS oavg FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL), pat AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), above AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.oavg AS above_by FROM pat p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.oavg), above_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS aavg FROM pat WHERE avg_hgb > (SELECT oavg FROM overall)) SELECT a.ID, a.avg_hgb, a.above_by, a.avg_hgb - b.aavg AS diff_from_above_group FROM above a CROSS JOIN above_avg b ORDER BY diff_from_above_group DESC LIMIT 10;
